retention.stated: Files inactive for 15 days are deleted — the shortest retention of any live host

egress.terms: No stated bandwidth cap; no speed limit claimed on the uploader.

tooling: Anonymous browser uploader plus a region selector; no published API. Optional account ID (no email) to track files. No rclone/webdav/S3 backend found.
chaining: Account-less uploads, so unlimited identities; the binding constraint is the 15-day inactivity deletion, which needs a re-access cron per file. At unlimited file size this is >= 500 GB per 'unit' trivially.
